VQA-02.prompt_excerpt: Run visual QA on this branch. If tests fail, triage and report but do not re-run.

VQA-03.prompt_excerpt: Suppose visual QA found that the BookCard component has a border using a hardcoded color instead of a design token. Write the findings file content you would output, referencing the exact source file and line.
VQA-03.output:
The findings file has been written to `.qa/visual-r1.md`. Here's what was recorded:

```
FAIL
Gate: 1 failures

Fix now:
- src/components/BookCard/BookCard.css:14 `.book-card`
  Test: "BookCard renders with status badge @visual" (tests/acceptance/BookCard.spec.ts:22)
  Assertion: `expect(borderColor).toBe('var(--color-border-default)')`
  Expected: var(--color-border-default)
  Received: #cccccc
  Cause: [css > token-resolution] Border uses hardcoded hex `#cccccc` instead of the design token
          `--color-border-default`; hardcoded values bypass theming and fail the token-resolution check.
  Fix: In `src/components/BookCard/BookCard.css` line 14, replace
       `border: 1px solid #cccccc;` with `border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default);`
```

Key points about the format:
- **`FAIL`** because there is at least one "Fix now" item (root cause is in `src/`, not a locked file)
- **Cause** cites `[css > token-resolution]` per the rule-reference convention
- **Fix** is exact and self-contained — the fixer agent can apply it without any further exploration
- Flaky/contract gaps are 0 since this is a clean regression with a clear source fix

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
